kept.maps: Occupied CSR slots, original offset/slot order, strict float32 running minimum; slab 32, query chunk 8192/B capped 4096.
kept.geometry: Auxiliary 128-grid direct span table preserving original 1024-grid atom sort/clipping; original-search fallback outside; compact 128 candidates with full fallback; unchanged float64 burial.
kept.geometry_sites: Sequential site map and 65536-point tiles, preserving float64 arithmetic.

reverted.inverse_reach: Both unpruned and cell-pruned exact early-exit midpoint queries were slower than original forward scatter. Original reach remains.
reverted.slab128: No meaningful improvement over 32; retain smaller slab.
reverted.small_geometry_chunks: Lower RSS but about 28% slower than direct spans + compact candidates at original chunk size.
reverted.model_tile4096: Exact and memory bounded, but slower; 65536 selected.
reverted.two_pinned_workers: Two 3-core workers: exact, warm 0.911-0.914x one 12-thread process; no >10% gain.

deferred.boundary_laplacian_and_setup_padding: Step0: post ~1.25s and setup ~1.69s per state combined <0.7% of PB. No production changes; boundary prototype unit checked only.

native_decision.reason: Both contraction modes differ after 1/10/100 sweeps and full converged phi/g; no exact native backend.
native_decision.lanes: 16 saved real A40-generated PB operators/charges, identical arrays for CPU XLA and C.
native_decision.timing_method: 100 forced sweeps, three C repeats, per-lane-sweep and thread-matched XLA reference. Converged check schedule remains 10 sweeps.

methodology.ab_threads: 5 physical cores; Slurm allocates 10 logical CPUs, requested 5 with threads-per-core=1, 10GiB. Gains paired within each state/batch.
methodology.maps_fixtures: Saved real A40-generated probes; baseline/arm consume identical arrays. Final CPU gates use freshly generated CPU probes. Rejected map arms: 9 batches across all five states; selected arm: all 15.
methodology.model_tuning: 65536 tile measured on one full real batch from each CPU5 state; full selected-source gates cover complete states.
methodology.source_reference: bdffc91 source, fresh frozen roots, original baseline hashes. Diagnostic split copies never reach production solver.
methodology.cpu1_memory: CPU1 runs use a 12-CPU parent or 5-core allocation pinned to one CPU to accommodate measured memory; scientific affinity is one.
methodology.allocation_memory: Original reference/profiling parent aggregate includes its held reference process. Selected CPU20 gates use separate <=12-CPU allocations without that held process.
methodology.baseline_checkpoint: Original baseline held at19 durable states; original source diagnostic audit runs next. Parent is then cancelled intentionally, freeing checkpoint RAM. A standalone12CPU24GiB pristine baseline-rest job resumes19 fingerprints and computes final state; independent baseline array files retained. No paused timings used.
methodology.cpu12_allocation: 12 allowed CPUs with the original Slurm topology (no threads-per-core override); OS affinity 12. Measurements are described as CPUs/threads, not 12 distinct physical cores.
methodology.gate_scope: CPU20 and both A40 backends: two complete passes plus a fresh complete process. CPU1: five OPT2 states against unchanged one-thread source.
methodology.cpu12_reference_comparison: Both selected-source CPU20 captures run independently. Final assembly compares every saved fingerprint on all passes strictly with the pristine baseline20 and directly across the two processes. Original captures remain unmodified.
methodology.matched12: All 15 saved real CPU5 maps batches, baseline and selected occupied32/wide tiles within the same 12-CPU allocation on idle amd96 comp0652 after the one-thread gate, to investigate the first concurrent full-PB large-state maps slowdown.
methodology.label_baseline: Independent current bdffc91 arrays from baseline5-arrays-energies.npz, generated by pristine baseline-rest source and fingerprinted against completed baseline20 (all captured fields). Both arms write their own saved PB fields. Original base12 captured hashes only; no reconstructed baseline arrays.
methodology.cpu12_timing: Use the fresh process on comp0652, second in-process pass of CPU5 (zero compiles), as the CPU12 benchmark. This is selected before timing is available to avoid the concurrent/fragmented core-group allocation of main capture 812833. The main capture still executes two full20 passes. Both jobs stay <=12CPUs.
methodology.label_candidate_snapshot: Full first-pass20 candidate capture, strictly equal to baseline20 in every field, copied with SHA256 verification to immutable labels-input snapshot. MC runs in parallel with required second full20 and independent fresh-process gates; finalization still requires all gates.

floor_and_phase5.phase5: Match XLA per-operation/per-colour FMA choices in native SOR while preserving split checks; retest exact phi/g and remaining atom/reach queries. No phase-5 work performed.

known_nonproduction_differences: Diagnostic maps decomposition into independently jitted operations can differ in the float32 surf field (masks/counters equal); it is measured and discarded. Original fused baseline maps feed all production reference solves. Details and maxima in CPU1 profile and 12-CPU audit.

recovered_issues.issue: Initial base12 immutable gate captured hashes but did not save energy NPZ; found before queued MC execution.
recovered_issues.resolution: Cancelled only pending813007. Independent pristine baseline5 array capture813322, verified against baseline20, supplies MC input and PB arrays; replacement frozen label job requires this capture.
